_comment: 21-tag prompt library for jigsaw puzzle source images. v2.0: subject pool expanded to 12-13 per tag (was 6-8) + new 'atmosphere' modifier dimension to maximize visual diversity and color entropy.
model_hint: z-image-turbo-fp8 (Apache 2.0, 8 steps, CFG 1.0) or flux2-klein-4b-fp8 (Apache 2.0, 4 steps).
critical_note: Distilled Turbo/Klein models run at CFG 1.0, so NEGATIVE PROMPTS ARE IGNORED. Dead-zone avoidance must be encoded in the POSITIVE description only. The 'avoid' field per tag is documentation for humans, not an active prompt.

generation._steps_note: 9 steps in ComfyUI = 8 actual NFE for Z-Image Turbo (sampler counts first/last point).

ratios._note: Generate small, then 2x upscale. 896x1344 -> 1792x2688. 1024x1024 -> 2048x2048. Both land in the 1440-2160 target band.

quality_suffix: highly detailed, intricate detail across the entire frame, dense visual texture, rich and varied color palette, busy composition, filled frame with corner-to-corner detail, sharp focus throughout, even balanced lighting
